title: 16:9 to 9:16 reframe and platform export (ffmpeg)
what_it_does: fit.py and crop.py fit footage to a target aspect (crop, pad, blur background); render.py templates (youtube, shorts, reels, tiktok, x, linkedin, podcast, audiogram) bundle the right size, length and loudness per platform.
when_to_use: Turning a YouTube video into a Reel or Short, or exporting for a platform.
why: Platform templates are the useful part; reframe is centre-or-manual, not face-aware (see the toolkit cutdown card for face tracking).
